en:
Original Game
Boxhead: 2Play Rooms  (Flash, 2007)

Created by  Sean Cooper  /  CrazyMonkeyGames
The Boxhead series is his original work. All credit for the design,
art and sound belongs to him.

This Project
A from-scratch Godot 4 remake, reverse engineered from the original SWF.
Classic values reconstructed from the game data: weapon stats, enemy
curves, upgrade table.
New: 18 procedural maps, 4-player local co-op, i18n.

Not affiliated with the original author.
Educational / non-commercial fan project.
zh:
原版游戏
Boxhead: 2Play Rooms（Flash，2007）

原作者  Sean Cooper / CrazyMonkeyGames
Boxhead 系列是他的原创作品，设计、美术、音效的功劳都属于他。

本项目
从原版 SWF 逆向重制的 Godot 4 项目。
数值全部从游戏数据还原：武器属性、敌人曲线、升级表。
新增：18 张程序化地图、4 人本地合作、多语言。

与原版作者无关。
学习 / 非商业性质的同人项目。

en:
[b]Move[/b]        W A S D
[b]Aim[/b]         Mouse
[b]Shoot[/b]       Left Mouse Button
[b]Next weapon[/b] Mouse Wheel Down
[b]Prev weapon[/b] Mouse Wheel Up
[b]Upgrades[/b]    TAB

[b]Goal[/b]
Kill every zombie in the room. Boxes give new weapons and upgrades.
Chain kills to unlock them faster. Barrels, fake walls and claymores
can be placed and detonated with the same button.

连续击杀解锁得更快。油桶、墙、阔剑可以放置并按同键引爆。
